verdict.rationale: Airwallex can be driven entirely headlessly. It documents an official CLI for working with the account from a command line, server-side SDKs with automatic retries and token refresh, and scoped API keys suited to least-privilege automation credentials. A separate sandbox environment allows safe automated testing without real money. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or examples, a documented non-interactive authentication flow for the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use, and the SDKs are still in beta.
